maxResolution.description: Highest resolution the recorder asks the screen and camera for (2160p = 4K, 3840×2160). Asked with `ideal` constraints: devices that deliver less are recorded at what they deliver.

frameRate.description: Frames per second asked of the devices and recorded from the canvas.

layouts.description: Layouts offered (the first is the default): camera bubble in a corner over the screen, side by side, screen only, camera only.

maxMinutes.description: Longest recording; the recorder stops by itself at the limit.

maxBytes.description: Largest upload in bytes (default 500 MB); refused while it is read, before it is stored.

shareLinks.description: Recordings can be shared with anyone by a revocable, unguessable link.
